findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 19 requests to 7 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

3 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: dotmetrics.net (Ipsos (Dotmetrics), audience measurement), google-analytics.com (Google, analytics), scorecardresearch.com (Comscore, audience measurement).
